Arena-55k, 5 replicates per cell, 8 null simulations, random blocks of 20 comparisons as resampling unit.
  > 
  > Result: detected = False in all 68 rows. Smallest detected size per departure: not reached, on either graph. Arena-55k, replicate-mean Delta (flip / delete), no departure 0.045 / 0.003; overdispersion 2: 0.064 / 0.028; position bias 2: 0.067 / 0.024; cyclic 0.8: 0.051 / -0.001; pair-specific 0.8: 0.053 / -0.002. So Delta rises by about 0.02 (flip) and 0.025 (delete) at the largest overdispersion and position sizes, nothing at the other departures, and never reaches the +-0.15 margin. The upper ends of the 95% intervals: at most 0.078 (position 2, flip).
  > 
  > What the Arena control cannot see (put this in the paper where Arena rows appear): the overdispersion is injected per random block of 20 comparisons, and with 55 models a block holds about one comparison of a given pair, so the term acts almost as pair-independent noise; the cluster SE ratio rises only from 0.82 to 0.94 at overdispersion 2 (design effect 1.11). The overdispersion that the SE ratio sees (design effect 6.2) is the MT-Bench-human one, unchanged. The Arena no-departure flip offset 0.045 is unchanged. Position bias 2 on Arena gives SE ratio 0.87.
  > 
  > paper-repo: please add the Arena rows to Table 4 / Appendix C and Fig. 6 from the CSV, and state the limitation above; results/README.md has the wording. Closing #7, #9 and #10 now; reopen if anything in the paper does not match.
